SlopFin 2.0 brings GPU-accelerated 4K menus, native picture subtitles, local voice search and redesigned playback controls to the PS5.

## What's new

### A smoother native 4K interface

Menus now render on the GPU, including backdrop shading. Moving between titles no longer rebuilds and uploads a full 4K background on the CPU. Home and Discover transitions, focus changes and scrolling have been refined throughout the app.

### Subtitles, rebuilt

- **Native PGS and DVD/VobSub overlays** for supported embedded MKV tracks, avoiding subtitle burn-in and the video transcode it requires. Unsupported tracks keep the server fallback.
- **Sharper text edges**, with smooth outlines, soft shadows, independent edge thickness and opacity, better wrapping and a proper top anchor.
- **Six font families**, normal and bold weights, and separate colours for text, outlines and backgrounds.
- **Picture subtitle size and placement controls**, with separate Reset appearance buttons for text and picture subtitles.
- Bright and dark previews make settings easier to judge. Track names preserve languages, regional variants, Forced and SDH labels.

### Voice search on the console

Open Search in Home or Discover and press **R3** to speak, or **✕** to type. Recognition runs locally after a one-time verified model download; no speech service account is required.

SlopFin uses the microphone selected in PS5 settings and respects mute. **✕ Finish** sits beside the search field while listening. Circle cancels recording, and dismissing the keyboard leaves Search open. Search hints sit directly below the field, and the keyboard uses consistent placement. Discover keeps the media filter selected before entering Search.

[Voice search guide](https://github.com/BeLikeBrett/SlopFin/blob/main/docs/VOICE_SEARCH.md)

### Cleaner playback controls

- Transparent media actions with a highlight that follows focus, plus a circular Play icon even before a title has progress.
- Resume groups its progress ring, label and remaining time together. **Start over** remains a separate action.
- A smaller **Up next** card with PlayStation prompts and a slide-in entrance.
- Smoother file-details scrolling, faster held d-pad navigation and a compact Circle Close prompt.
- Autoplay moves to the far right, after Debug.

## Fixes and reliability

- Backing out updates Resume immediately from the displayed playback timestamp. Final progress reports are ordered and retried after transient failures; playback duration keeps its original precision.
- Mark watched clears stale resume progress and updates cached library rows and title pages.
- Returning from playback restores a populated media page, including playback started without an existing detail screen.
- Latest show rows include watched series and sort by their newest added episode.
- Update shutdown uses the verified installer helper to close and restart the app reliably.

## Updating

Use **Settings → Updates**, or download **SlopFin-2.00-folder.zip** below and replace the complete `PPSA99001` folder. Your sign-in, subtitle preferences, device identity and per-series autoplay settings are preserved. Keep `/data/slopfin/config.json` when replacing the folder manually.

The update package was installed and tested on PS5 firmware **8.20**, and accepted by the current updater and legacy readers from **1.08, 1.09, 1.12, 1.13 and 1.17**. Full regression tests, lint, Linux preview and native build checks passed.

Versions **1.07 and earlier** need a one-time manual folder replacement; some restricted **1.10/1.11** installations may also need it. If an older client reports **The app did not close**, close it from the PS5 system menu and replace the folder once. [Update and recovery guide](https://github.com/BeLikeBrett/SlopFin/blob/main/docs/UPDATES.md).

Jellyfin's minimum-resume policy still applies to server bookmarks; very early progress may only remain in the running client. Voice recognition can need correction for unusual titles. Firmware, media and audio equipment can affect compatibility; see the [compatibility guide](https://github.com/BeLikeBrett/SlopFin/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md).

**Downloads:** the folder ZIP is the installable app; `SHA256SUMS` verifies the downloads. The FFmpeg source archive is provided for license compliance and is not needed to install SlopFin.
